column1: # Marker manifest for the Kalamari curation-triage tool (Tier 2).
# One row per (identification task, component). A task is the question a
# confounded taxon poses ("is this Bacillus anthracis or another member of the
# B. cereus group?"); a component is one tool's contribution to answering it.
# Several rows share a task_id on purpose: the design (CURATION_TRIAGE_DESIGN.md
# section 5) requires Listeria serogroup / MLST-CC / cgMLST-LIN to stay SEPARATE
# un-merged fields, and requires the Yersinia plasmid screen to be a pre-screen
# rather than the classifier.
# A marker call depends on THREE things that move independently, so all three are
# pinned here and stamped into every ledger record:
#   1. the software        -> tool, conda_package, conda_build
#   2. the database        -> database, database_version, db_pin_class
#   3. our reading of it   -> interpretation_rule_version (implemented in markers.py)
# Recording only the first two makes a changed call unattributable. A changed
# call must be classifiable as a software, database, threshold or rule effect.
# EVERY conda_build AND database_version BELOW WAS READ FROM AN INSTALLED TOOL
# on 2026-08-04, not from documentation. Two rows that the 2026-08-02 research
# pass listed as pinned are recorded as `gap` here, because the tool they name
# has no packaged CLI and is not installed: the Yersinia cgMLST classifier and
# the Listeria cgMLST/LIN component. Calling them pinned when nothing can run
# them would misrepresent what the tool actually checks.
# Columns
#   task_id                   stable task key, also used as the ledger lead key
#   component                 which part of the task this row supplies
#   trigger_taxids            NCBI taxids that route a unit to this task (lineage
#                             containment, same rule as confounded_manifest.tsv)
#   regime                    A = ANI cannot split, marker call OVERRIDES ANI
#                             B = ANI resolves; the typer supplies the LABEL only
#                             -  = context only, never a species verdict
#   role                      classifier | pre-screen | label | context | gap
#   tool                      resolver tool
#   conda_package             bioconda package name ('' if not packaged)
#   conda_build               INSTALLED version-build ('' if not installed)
#   database                  the reference data the tool reads
#   database_version          the version the installed tool reports
#   db_pin_class              a bundled-in-package | b Zenodo DOI | c dated DB
#                             | d freeze-and-checksum | e no version of its own
#   reproducibility_anchor    what must be recorded to make the call reproducible
#   markers                   defining markers as gene:context, ';'-separated
#   corroborating             markers that may support but NEVER decide alone
#   thresholds                tool thresholds we pin
#   interpretation_rule_version   our own versioned reading of the tool output
#   status                    pinned | gap (gap = no runnable tool for this row)
#   note
# Update gate: a new tool or DB pin enters production only after (1) the artifact
# has an immutable digest, (2) the fixed validation panel is re-run, (3) every
# call difference is classified as software / database / threshold / rule, and
# (4) this file and the changelog are updated.
task_id
shigella_eiec_vs_escherichia_coli
column18: Kalamari holds no Shigella unit; the task guards the E. coli pick. Two install caveats verified 2026-08-04: the env needs setuptools added (the tool dies on import pkg_resources without it) and --tmpdir must be passed or the run dies after writing a header-only output file. conda-meta says 1.3.4 but the installed dist-info says 1.3.2; the tool prints no version, so neither can be confirmed from the tool itself.

column1: bacillus_anthracis_vs_b_cereus_group
column9: bundled seq_*_db resources + local PubMLST copy
column12: exact build or container digest + bundled DB SHA-256
column18: BTyper3 supplies group taxonomy plus a marker profile, NOT a standalone anthracis call; turning that into "is this anthracis" is our rule. 3.4 reports the REVISED nomenclature: species(ANI) is the genomospecies (e.g. mosaicus) and the familiar name is subspecies(ANI) (e.g. cereus). It writes to a file, not stdout. rpoB is dropped from the marker list: BTyper3 does not report it.

column1: yersinia_pestis_vs_y_pseudotuberculosis
column12: complete frozen scheme snapshot SHA-256 + pinned allele caller
column18: The research pass named this the classifier, but there is no packaged CLI and no allele caller is pinned, so NOTHING can run it today. Recorded as a gap rather than as a pin: with no classifier the Yersinia task returns "undecided", which is correct, instead of falling back to plasmid presence -- the very mistake that removed abricate from this role.

column1: yersinia_pestis_vs_y_pseudotuberculosis
column12: conda build + bundled scheme snapshot SHA-256
column18: Runs, but is CONTEXT only and is never fed in as a species call. Verified 2026-08-04: the classical 7-locus ST cannot separate Y. pestis from Y. pseudotuberculosis, because pestis is a clone nested inside pseudotuberculosis. It emits no header line; columns are positional.

column1: yersinia_pestis_vs_y_pseudotuberculosis
column10: vfdb 4592 seqs, plasmidfinder 488 seqs, both dated 2026-Apr-3
column12: freeze whole $ABRICATE_DB dir + SHA-256 + record abricate --list
column18: Cheap triage only; a plasmid hit never makes the species call. Verified 2026-08-04 on the Kalamari Y. pseudotuberculosis pick: these two databases contain NONE of pst, ypo2088, yihN or opgG, and the run returned only lcrV/lcrG, which the design already excludes as context rather than discriminators. So the pre-screen currently adds no discriminating power at all.

column1: listeria_monocytogenes_serogroup_lineage_cc
column12: exact build + bundled DB SHA-256 + thresholds
column18: Doumith multiplex pattern. Serogroup is NOT a lineage; keep it a separate field. Gene presence is reported as FULL/PARTIAL/NONE, and only FULL counts as present.

column1: listeria_monocytogenes_serogroup_lineage_cc
column12: conda build + bundled scheme snapshot SHA-256
column18: Supplies the sequence type only. It reports NO clonal complex and NO lineage, and no ST->CC->lineage table is pinned, so the lineage field stays empty rather than being inferred from the ST.

column1: listeria_monocytogenes_serogroup_lineage_cc
column12: independent full snapshot SHA-256 + pinned allele caller + local regression panel
column18: No packaged CLI and no pinned allele caller, so the broad lineage I-IV cannot be called today. This is why the four Kalamari lineage units get no lineage verdict from markers; their check comes from the ANI panel instead.

column1: salmonella_subspecies_and_serovar
column18: Supplies subspecies and serovar labels for the 11 Salmonella units; ANI/panel decides membership. The env needs setuptools added, like shigeifinder. No CLI flag reports the DB version; it is read from the bundled dbstatus.txt.

column1: salmonella_subspecies_and_serovar
column18: Second, independent antigen call; a disagreement with SISTR is itself worth surfacing. Its "Predicted identification" also names the subspecies in prose, giving a free cross-check on SISTR's cgmlst_subspecies.

column1: clostridium_botulinum_group_and_bont_type
column12: amrfinder -V + amrfinder --database_version + dated DB dir SHA-256
column18: The one tool with a first-class dated DB version, so a changed call is attributable to a DB update rather than to biology. The installed DB is exactly the 2026-05-15.1 the research pass named. Symbols use an underscore (bont_E3) and the column is "Element symbol", not "Gene symbol".

column1: clostridium_botulinum_group_and_bont_type
column18: Genomic group I-IV still needs a separate genome-wide classifier. Until one is pinned, the group verdict for the two Kalamari group units comes from the ANI panel, never from the toxin type: group I and group II strains can carry overlapping bont types.

column1: escherichia_coli_serotype_pathotype
column9: bundled O/H allele set + pathotype DB + MASH species sketch
column12: conda build + DatabaseVer column + Zenodo sketch version
column18: Context for the E. coli pick and for STEC deposits; never a species verdict. Reports its own DatabaseVer per row, which is the cleanest DB pin of the bundled-database tools.

column1: generic_marker_fallback
column10: vfdb 4592 seqs, plasmidfinder 488 seqs, both dated 2026-Apr-3
column12: freeze whole $ABRICATE_DB dir + SHA-256 + record abricate --list
column18: Generic wrapper for a one-off custom marker question. Never a classifier. abricate --list also carries argannot, bacmet2, card, ecoh, ecoli_vf, megares, ncbi, resfinder, upec_expec_vf and victors, all dated 2026-Apr-3.

column1: generic_marker_fallback
column18: Preferred generic screen where a dated DB matters more than breadth.
